1: Allah ke Rasool ﷺ ne naagawari se peshani sikor li aur munh phera.
2: Yeh us waqt hua jab Abdullah bin Umm Maktoom hidayat talash karte hue haazir hue. Woh naabina thay, aur us waqt aaye jab Rasool ﷺ mushrikeen ke sardaron mein mashgool thay, is umeed par ke woh hidayat pa jayein.
3: Aey Rasool ﷺ, aap ko kya maloom, shayad yeh naabina apne gunahon se paak ho jaye?
4: Ya shayad woh un nasihaton se sabaq le jo woh aap se sunta hai, aur un se faida uthaye?
5: Aur woh log jo apni daulat ki wajah se aap ke laaye hue paigham par iman lane ki zaroorat mehsoos nahin karte,
6: aap un ke peechhe lage rehte hain aur un ki taraf mutawajjah hote hain.
7: Agar woh Allah ki taraf tauba na kar ke apne gunahon se paak na ho, to aap par is ka kya ilzaam?
8: Aur jo aap ke paas daudta hua aata hai, bhalai ki talash mein,
9: aur apne Rubb se darta hai,
10: aap us se bekhabar ho kar doosron mein mashgool rehte hain, yani mushrikeen ke sardaron mein.
11: Aisa na hona chahiye; yeh Quran to sirf un logon ke liye nasihat aur yaad-dihani hai jo tawajjoh dete hain.
12: Pas jo Allah ko yaad karna chahe, usey yaad kare, aur jo kuch is Quran mein hai us se sabaq le.
13: Kyunke yeh Quran farishton ke paas mubarak sahifon mein hai.
14: Woh sahife buland maqam par rakhe gaye hain, paak hain; un tak koi gandagi aur napaki nahin pahunchti.
15: Aur woh farishton mein se un ke haathon mein hain jo paigham pahunchane wale hain.
16: Woh apne Rubb ke nazdeek mukarram hain, bhalai aur farmanbardari bakasrat karne wale hain.
17: Kafir insan par lanat hai; Allah ke saath us ka kufr kitna sakht hai!
18: Allah ne usey kis cheez se paida kiya, ke usey zameen par takabbur karne aur us ka inkaar karne ka haqq ho?
19: Us ne usey ek haqeer paani se paida kiya, aur martabon mein us ki takhleeq ki tadbeer ki.
20: Phir in martabon ke baad us ne us ke liye maa ke pet se nikalna aasan kar diya.
21: Phir jab us ke liye muqarrar ki hui umr poori ho gayi, Allah ne usey maut di aur us ke liye qabr banai, jis mein woh dobara zinda kiye jane tak rehta hai.
22: Phir jab Allah chahega, usey hisaab aur badle ke liye dobara zinda karega.
23: Maamla waisa nahin jaisa yeh kafir samajhta hai, ke us ne Allah ke haqq poore kar diye; kyunke us ne woh faraiz ada nahin kiye jo Allah ne us par rakhe thay.
24: Pas jo insan Allah ka inkaar karta hai, usey apne khane par gaur karna chahiye: yeh us tak kis tarah pahuncha?
25: Us ki ibtida us baarish se hoti hai jo aasman se zor ke saath aur kasrat se barasti hai.
26: Phir maine zameen ko phaar diya, to woh podey ugaane lagi.
27: Phir main us par anaj ugata hoon, yani gandum, makai waghairah.
28: Aur main us par taaza angoor aur chara ugata hoon, taake woh tumhare chaupayon ki ghiza bane.
29: Aur main us par zaitoon aur khajoor ke darakht bhi ugata hoon.
30: Aur main us par ghane baag aur darakht bhi ugata hoon.
31: Aur main us par phal ugata hoon, aur woh cheezein bhi jinhein tumhare chaupaye charte hain.
32: Yeh sab tumhare faide ke liye hai aur tumhare chaupayon ke faide ke liye.
33: Pas jab woh bari chikh aayegi jo kaanon ko behra kar degi, yani doosra phoonka,
34: us din insan apne bhai se bhaagega,
36: aur apni biwi aur bachchon se bhaagega.
37: Un mein se har ek aisi haalat mein hoga ke us din ki shiddat ki pareshani ki wajah se woh un se bekhabar hoga.
38: Us din khush-naseebon ke chehre roshan honge.
39: Woh khushi se hans rahe honge, us cheez par jo Allah ne apni rehmat se un ke liye tayyar ki hai.
40: Aur us din bad-naseeb logon ke chehron par gard pari hogi.
42: Jin ka yeh haal bayan hua, wohi log hain jin mein kufr aur nafarmani dono jama thin.
